1.3.5 -> 1.3.6 (DSH baseline dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1 -> dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2; no breaking changes). 1.3.5 refreshed to dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2: 187 commits, 0 self-declared breaking commits; official packages unchanged (325 -> 325, no rename or removal), the base patch blob is byte-identical, SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION is still 4 and the tool DSL blobs are unchanged. The only additions are one UI slot (sidebar.right.tab.files.actions; declared/union/public counts now 125/127/~90) and, outside the usual six dimensions, plugin-side Config keys (cordis-host-runner gains clientInspectTimeoutMs; tool-ask-user gains its first Config with mode=legacy|timed) - both additive and non-breaking, which is why that scan is now a routine seventh dimension. 1.3.6 is a pre-publish audit fix: the settings-card templates (02-templates T9 and the 02b official-template volume) still reproduced the pre-0.1.7 settings mechanism whose entry points (ctx.settingsScope, settings.register, settings.get) no longer exist in the source tree; T9 was rewritten to the current Config-derived form (ctx.configForms.get) with per-line citations, and the 02b volume - which is a line-by-line upstream excerpt - only gained a staleness banner. A markdown table-integrity defect (blank lines left inside the version ledgers by successive appends) was also fixed across 13/15/api-claims.

1.3.2 -> 1.3.4 (DSH baseline dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2 -> dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1; no breaking changes). 1.3.2 refreshed to dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2. 1.3.3 refreshed to dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1: 4 new official packages (dsh-otel, dsh-client-product-analytics, dsh-client-ui-settings-session-log, dsh-experimental-schedule-bundle), base patch +1 plugin row (otel) and +1 config key (maxRequestBytes), and upstream now ships a 4th bundled development skill (agent-experience) plus a new cordis-plugin-development reference on user-actions ('one operation, two callers'). 1.3.4 fixes defects in this skill itself: a general citation-drift checker was added and 24 stale file/line citations were corrected against the new baseline source tree (one of them was a citation whose quoted code had been rewritten upstream: profile.ts bundle resolution now reads `bundle`, not `declared`); three maintenance-checker defects were fixed, including one that made a structure gate return exit code 0 unconditionally (a silent false pass); and outdated content was cleaned up (a removed service no longer appears in the live service table; stale editorial notes were dropped).

1.3.1: baseline dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2 -> dsh-v0.1.7-rc.1 (skill 1.1.0 -> 1.3.1). BREAKING: (1) the settings mechanism was rebuilt end to end - installSection / SettingsScope / settings.yaml and the hand-written client card family are gone; forms are now derived from a plugin's Config schema, persistence goes through the config editor writing the profile's Cordis patch, and writes are optimistic-concurrent (expectedRevision mismatch raises SettingsConflictError). (2) SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION 3 -> 4, with a new migration package. (3) UI slots: 17 added, conversation.session.header.leading removed (counts now 121 / 123 / ~86). (4) base patch key maxInlineBytes -> maxInlineTokens. ADDED: DefineToolOptions.deferLoading and projectContent; the CLI flag --dump-config-schema (the config-dump family became three-way mutually exclusive); a new chapter documenting that upstream now ships its own plugin-development skills and templates (cordis-plugin-development and friends); the plugin_manager tool (8 actions); and a correction that cordis_inspect what:"client" is legacy shorthand for the real cordis_inspect_list / cordis_inspect_query tools.

1.1.0: baseline dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.1. Absorbed the exec-runtime rename (ctx.codeRuntime -> ctx.ptcRuntime, no aliases), E2B removal plus the new SSH family, removal of agent/session-start (agent/created is now serial), the non-transactional loader (apply failures are logged, not rolled back; duplicate ids are no longer rejected), and new capability faces (browserUse / computerUse / mcpResources / terminalController). Probe assertions 48 -> 56 with a new content-negation mode. Also a pre-release consistency audit that fixed stale duplicate-id wording, eight line-count claims and one stale upstream excerpt.

Cited-source set converged to MIT / Apache-2.0 / BSD-3-Clause (no copyleft). Apache-2.0 section 4 duties completed: change notice added, package-level loopx NOTICE reproduced, MemOS attribution corrected. BSD-3-Clause adopted with bundled licence text and no-endorsement clause. One AGPL-3.0 source removed from the cited set; its eight implementation pitfalls deleted and the lessons behind them restated as original advice. 50 files, zero deleted.

License compliance: removed all AGPL-3.0 verbatim code (64 segments / 253 lines -> 0) and re-sourced mechanism content to the MIT-licensed official DSH sources; LICENSE now carries the DeepSeek MIT attribution and a full source x license x location table; WeKnora corrected from NOASSERTION to MIT.

Resource-layer loadability fix. description trimmed 1032->972 chars (back within the 1024 spec limit). The community casebook (6.6k lines) is split into 10a-10d, one volume per source direction, plus a 38-line index; the two upstream source appendices of the template library move to 02b/02c. Content relocated line-for-line, original filenames kept, zero deletions. 18 cross-direction duplicated section numbers now carry a direction prefix ("# 一、" -> "# A · 一、"), so number-based search no longer returns hits from four unrelated directions. Nine large references gained per-file navigation blocks declaring the boundary between the task-oriented digest and the upstream source archive. SKILL.md's resource index is rewritten as a loading-routing table carrying trigger / read-mode / load-cost per resource. references: 17 -> 23 files.

Security fix from the ClawHub audit. Both accepted T03 findings are fixed: MCP examples no longer launch an unpinned package while forwarding credentials (npx: my-mcp-server@1.2.3; uvx: ouroboros-ai[mcp]==1.4.0), and both now state that the downloaded child process can read every credential in env and runs with DSH privileges. README (zh+en) and both skeleton READMEs gained a three-constraint section: pin exact versions, forward one least-privilege revocable key, split download from execute. All 13 reference file headers became plain descriptive blockquotes, and the one quoted block the static scan flagged is now a narrative paraphrase.

README rewritten as a bilingual front page: README.en.md added, README.md fully rewritten (Chinese, cross-linked). Installation is now client-agnostic - the skill is presented as a plain Agent Skills package usable in any client that can load a SKILL.md, with a per-client discovery-path table, real OpenClaw install commands, a symlink recipe for sharing one canonical copy, and the spec rule that the directory name must match the frontmatter name. Usage is documented beginner-to-advanced in four levels with copy-ready code.

Initial release of DSH Plugin Development skill.

- Guides developers through the end-to-end process of building, debugging, packaging, and publishing DSH (DeepSeek Harness) / Cordis plugins.
- Includes 12 templates, 23 catalogued pitfalls, and copy-ready prompts to streamline plugin development.
- Enforces a mandatory version gate requiring explicit API verification due to frequent upstream breaking changes.
- Provides decision flows, engineering conventions, and troubleshooting steps for common plugin issues.
- Reference material and tools to assist both human and AI agents in maintaining up-to-date and compatible plugins.
